reviews.body:
Good follow-up to #1964, @pcbeingused333. SageMaker was the same gap: a blank `content` came back as an empty string with a nil error.

The fix reads right at `caebec5`: `GetCompletion` in `pkg/ai/amazonsagemaker.go` now runs the content through `checkCompletionContent` like the other backends, and the new test covers blank, missing and a non-empty control. Build, lint and tests are green, so I'm approving the code.

One thing before it can land: `validate` is red because of the title. This repo only allows the `deps` scope, so `fix(ai): ...` is rejected (`Unknown scope "ai"`). Retitle to `fix: treat blank SageMaker generation as an error` and the check should pass. The two commits are fine as they are.
